pages.quiz:
GEOGRAPHY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Weather is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Weather never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Weather as rumours only.
   C. Explain Weather with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Weather.

2. Which statement about Vegetation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation.
   B. Explain Vegetation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Vegetation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Vegetation as rumours only.

3. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.

4. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

5. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Name the president

6. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   B. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   D. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Mass Wasting is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Mass Wasting with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Mass Wasting never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Mass Wasting as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Mass Wasting.

8. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   B. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   D. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Elementary Surveying is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Elementary Surveying as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Elementary Surveying.
   D. Say Elementary Surveying never happens in Kenya.

10. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nairobi

11. Which statement about Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in.
   D. Treat Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in as rumours only.

12. Which statement about Soils is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Soils.
   B. Explain Soils with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Soils as rumours only.
   D. Say Soils never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Wildlife and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Tourism and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Transport and Communication and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
